name: Train
tips: `sl` exists because people type `sl` for `ls`. The lesson: read what you typed before you press Enter.
Press Tab while you type a command: the shell completes the name, so typos like `sl` can't happen.
Ctrl+C sends the SIGINT signal, which stops most programs. The `sl` train ignores it on purpose: just wait.
`sl -l` draws a little train, `sl -F` makes it fly. `man sl` lists every option.
personal: Choo choo! You typed `sl` and here I am.
All aboard! Next stop: your home folder.
I'm the oldest joke in the terminal, and I still run on time.
